test_name: the filler fills all four missing fields, and overwrites none of them
measured_detail: The assertion is a regex /d\.alternatives/ against the deployed trigger source. The deployed body no longer uses a plpgsql RECORD named d - it declares v_alts, v_decision and v_amt, because an unassigned RECORD raised 55000 on first field reference. The behaviour the test names (read alternatives from the decision_log row the gate just wrote) is present and correct; the expected identifier is pre-fix.

test_name: the rpc invoker is scheduled on production
measured_detail: fn_action_invoke_rpc has no active cron entry. cron.job shows action_invoke_rpc_5min (231), action_invoke_dispatch_5min (230) and action_invoke_collect_5min (266) all active=false. That is the Phase C business-automation hold Gate 17 requires to remain in force, so the test asserts active=true against a state Phase C deliberately holds off. Unresolved: no profile owns or excludes it.
